event_chain.summary: Intrusion into mobile device management infrastructure (method not disclosed)
Access to staff names and mobile numbers

summary: On 30 January 2026 the European Commission's central infrastructure that manages staff mobile devices (its mobile device management platform) identified traces of a cyberattack that may have resulted in access to the names and mobile numbers of some staff members. The Commission found no evidence that the mobile devices themselves were compromised.
